pull_request.title: Muon System: add DD4hep chamber XML and overlap validation
pull_request.head: codex/muon-dd4hep-prototype
pull_request.body:
## Executive summary

Refs #92 and #93. The standalone muon compact now defines **22 reusable chamber shapes** once and expands **936 placements** through native phi/z loops. This addresses [the PR94 review comment](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/94#issuecomment-6360225046): detector XML shrinks from **583,236 to 28,907 bytes** (95.0%), and from **5,639 to 255 lines**, while preserving the source geometry and identifiers within the unchanged numerical validation tolerance.

The first envelope/transport stage contains 36 finite warm-toroid reservations in three shared unions. All chambers and reservations remain nonsensitive Air. Drift-tube internals are the subsequent stage of #93. DES-039/DES-040 remain DRAFT; this isolated prototype is stacked on the toroid branch containing merged PR90 and grants no engineering sign-off or production integration.

## Change

- Share one DD4hep Solid/Volume for each of 15 barrel and 7 endcap templates, including the smaller hardware-clearance families.
- Use 21 actual phi orbits and 56 source-derived rows. Six multi-position z rows cover 288 placements; other rows preserve their actual nonuniform axial positions. All 936 placements retain their source names and chamber/station/side IDs. No uniform eta grid or repacking is introduced.
- Keep original source frames and vertices in the independent manifest. The native audit recovers those frames from the centred templates, checks all world vertex sets, and verifies 22 shared native solids/volumes.
- Audit actual XML semantics after hashing, with negative controls for malformed references, recurrence counts/phase/pitches, units, vertices and identities. Keep the fail-closed overlap gate and MC-truth persistence checks.

[Schema and reproduction](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/muon-dd4hep-prototype/prototypes/muon/README.md), [template refactor evidence](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/muon-dd4hep-prototype/docs/validation/DES-040/dd4hep-templates-2026-10-23/README.md), [historical first-stage evidence](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/muon-dd4hep-prototype/docs/validation/DES-040/dd4hep-2026-10-23/README.md).

## Validation

DD4hep 1.38 / ROOT 6.40.04 / Geant4 11.4.3. All **16 focused tests** pass on macOS Python 3.11 and 3.14, including a one-ULP libm-drift control. A clean committed-source replay at `4605ad6ba160c478a324ca1aa30a7cd3c934cd4e` verifies:

- 936 unique chamber IDs, 22 shared native Volume/Solid objects, and all source shapes/frames within the unchanged **1e-10 m** tolerance; maximum native vertex residual **1.00878e-14 m**.
- 288 toroid CSG primitive instances and 25,248 occupancy probes, with zero mismatches.
- **Zero overlaps** at **0.00001 mm** numerical tolerance, converted to ROOT units explicitly; the overlap collection is inspected rather than trusting the stock utility's exit code.
- **1,000 persisted 20 GeV gamma events**, with the same complete primary-momentum bank and event-by-event particle multiplicities as the original retained run.

The requested DDSim `uniform` option remains flat polar theta/azimuth. The empty-event-container action creates no hit collections. This Air-envelope result supplies no material, drift-response, efficiency, momentum-resolution or magnetic-transport validation. HCAL and frame/support transport remain outside this compact. The later tube model must preserve the explicit 30 mm radius-versus-diameter distinction and document containment/material/readout choices.

The [independent PhysVal review](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/muon-dd4hep-prototype/docs/validation/DES-040/dd4hep-templates-2026-10-23/physics-review.md) at `d5803de8bac013d918140585bd2c00de15632011` reproduces all 15 tests and the native audit, inspects both ROOT artifacts, and finds no actionable defects for this bounded refactor.

The [CI follow-up](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/94#issuecomment-6361605900) exposed platform-dependent last digits from angle reconstruction. The exporter now reads the original source angles and uses deterministic Decimal arithmetic for serialized expansion diagnostics. Frozen-export byte equality and geometry tolerances remain enforced. [Correction and committed native replay](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/muon-dd4hep-prototype/docs/validation/DES-040/dd4hep-ci-2026-10-23/README.md) retain the new hashes and results.

## Dashboard and validation

- [x] Updated project/tracking.json with the review follow-up and retained evidence; tube internals remain separately planned.
- [x] Ran relevant local tests and project/session/agent validators; token-site validation/build passes.
- [x] Retained exact source/execution/review revisions and all earlier evidence; no human approval inferred.
- [x] Source geometry/layout dimensions are unchanged, so no R-Z regeneration is required.

events.text:
Implemented exact936-chamber Air envelopes and three shared warm unions representing36coils; source geometry and magnetic parameters unchanged. Reused the complete pinned element table after the sparse subset caused ROOT failure. Stock overlap exit codes alone are insufficient; native solids/transforms/IDs and the overlap list are checked. Explicit teardown avoids the local ROOT mutex shutdown failure. DDG4 requires a nonnull event hit container to persist output; the coordinator added a small empty-container event action without hit collections and selected native ROOT output. The successful run contains1000persisted events.

Tube internals remain a distinct next stage: requested30mm radius is not silently changed to the30mm-diameter precedent. Need documented gas/wall/pitch/separation/readout/finite-trapezoid containment. No human sign-off, design acceptance or production integration. Separate independent PhysVal review and committed-source replay follow the initial source snapshot.
